messages:
From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@healthprime.com>

Cc: sre@healthprime.com, carlos.mendez@healthprime.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production impact in us-west-az5 — sudden 5xx and token throughput drop

Ben —

We started seeing a sharp rise in 5xx on our inference routes served from us-west-az5 around 08:50 PT. Latency has climbed from 220ms p50 to ~1.2s p50 and p95 is spiking above 3s. Throughput has fallen by ~40% on our busiest endpoints, and retry loops are amplifying traffic. This is affecting our checkout flow.

We opened an incident on our side (INC-1768) and attached the HealthPrime graphs. Can you confirm whether Redwood has any known degradation in AZ5, and if there are recommended cross-region failover steps we should take immediately? We need wraparound updates to customers by 10:00 PT.

Attaching: hp-graph-0800-0900.png

— Alice
Product Ops | HealthPrime
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@healthprime.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jul 2028 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact in us-west-az5 — sudden 5xx and token throughput drop

Alice —

Thanks for the alert and the graphs. We see elevated error rates and latency in our telemetry for us-west-az5 starting ~08:48 PT; our infra shows a KV cache pressure event on the AZ5 GPU pool and a partial scheduler congestion that caused tail latency amplification.

Immediate actions we've kicked off:
- Promoted cross-region routing policy to route traffic for HealthPrime to us-west-az2 (canary 20% -> 100% within 8m).
- Activated KV cache mitigation (prefix-only caching) for the affected models to reduce memory churn.
- Spun up two dedicated burst workers and set a temporary QPS cap to limit retry amplification.

Next steps for us (ETA in parentheses):
- Complete 100% geo-shift to us-west-az2 and confirm steady p95 (target within 12 minutes). (09:37 PT)
- Follow-up postmortem once stabilized with root cause hypotheses. (by EOD)

I've looped in Hannah (regional ops) and Marissa (customer liaison) for coordination and Vivek for executive summary if we need credits/SLAs. I'll update you at 09:40 PT with status.

Attachments: mitigation-playbook-v1.pdf (playbook excerpt)

— Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

- Customer impact: Checkout failure was limited to a 14-minute window; estimated successful requests affected ~3.6% of daily volume for HealthPrime (prelim).
- Credit ask: recommend proactively offering a one-week usage credit on their monthly invoice given business impact (Marissa to propose language).
- RCA seeds: KV cache pressure + scheduler latched on a subset of long-context jobs (we are investigating quantization codepath interactions).

Action items assigned:
* Marissa: draft customer-facing note and credit proposal (ETA 10:00 PT).
* Vivek: prepare an executive one-pager if HealthPrime requests C-level brief (standby).
* Ben: preserve logs and KV cache dumps for postmortem (do not rotate).

Subject: Re: [ACTION REQUIRED] HealthPrime AZ5 — elevated 5xx / latency / throughput degradation

Alice —

Thanks for your patience — quick status update and proposed remediation:

What happened (short):
- Between 08:48–09:02 PT traffic routed to us-west-az5 experienced sudden 5xx and elevated latency due to a KV cache pressure event that amplified scheduler tail latency for a subset of long-context customers.

What we did (short):
- Initiated geo-shift to us-west-az2 by 09:36 PT; traffic fully routed and p95 returned to acceptable range within 4 minutes of completion.
- Applied a temporary QPS cap and disabled full-prefix KV caching for the impacted models to remove cache churn.

Immediate asks for HealthPrime:
1) Confirm whether you want traffic permanently anchored to us-west-az2 for the next 48 hours while we complete an in-depth RCA. (We recommend this for minimal risk.)
2) Accept our offer of a one-week usage credit to offset the business impact; we will calculate the amount and send the credit note for approval.

Attachments: healthprime-az5-error-graph.png (customer graph), mitigation-playbook-v1.pdf

If you’d like a C-level note or a short exec call, Vivek is available after 11:00 PT.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
